name: adb-plugin-tempvoice
description:
Automatically creates and manages temporary voice channels when users join a designated channel (e.g., 'Create Channel').
Features:
- Automatic channel creation on join
- Configurable templates, category, and auto-delete delay
- Commands: setup, name, limit, lock, unlock, permit, deny, claim, rename, bitrate
author: DeadIndian

process.persistentReason: Runs un-isolated (system:raw-client) to create and manage voice channels on voiceStateUpdate events (guild.channels.create, channel.edit, channel.delete), and to enforce permissions and bitrate — the guild.channels API and voice state inspection are outside the sandboxed RPC surface.

view.title: channelId
view.empty: You have no active temp voice channels in this server.

creationChannelId.description: Discord snowflake ID of the designated voice channel where temporary voice channels are spawned

categoryId.description: Discord snowflake ID of the category where temporary channels are created

nameTemplate.description: Template for temporary channel names. Must include {username} or {user}.

autoDeleteDelay.description: Delay in minutes before empty temporary channels are auto-deleted

maxChannels.description: Maximum number of temporary channels allowed per guild (0 = unlimited)

bitrateDefault.description: Default bitrate for new temporary channels (bps)

userLimitDefault.description: Default user limit for temporary channels (0 = none)
